**AGREE:**  
- Management highlighted “strong franchise” and “steady market‑share gains” in deposits and advances. The annual net‑profit numbers show a continued upward trend, rising from ₹73,440 cr in FY 25 to ₹79,219 cr in FY 26, confirming that the bank’s earnings are still growing despite a tougher environment.  

**DIVERGE:**  
- In the FY 26 earnings call the CEO said net‑income growth “clocked at 11 %,” yet the supplied profit figures show an increase of only about 8 % year‑on‑year (₹73,440 cr → ₹79,219 cr). Likewise, the CFO’s comment that margins may have “bottomed out” is not reflected in any disclosed margin numbers; the only quantitative hint is a modest quarterly profit dip (June 2026 ₹20,383 cr vs. March 2026 ₹21,074 cr), suggesting margins have not yet improved as implied.
